Of course! Getting your new mattress set up correctly is key to a great first experience. Here’s what you need to know: 🛏️

Place it on a Proper Foundation: Before you even unbox it, make sure your bed frame is ready. The Titan Plus Core needs a foundation with solid support and minimal flex. This can be a slatted base (with slats no more than 5 inches apart), a box foundation, or a solid platform.
Allow for an Adjustment Period: It's completely normal for a new mattress to feel different at first. We recommend sleeping on it for at least 30 nights. This gives the mattress time to break in and for your body to adjust to the new level of support.
Rotate, Don't Flip: To ensure the mattress wears evenly over time, you should rotate it 180 degrees (from head to foot) every 6 to 8 months. However, it's designed with support layers on the bottom and comfort layers on top, so it should never be flipped over.

Following these steps will help you get the best possible comfort and support from your new mattress right from the start!
